values.title: Database branching
values.body:
Every pull request can now get its own isolated copy of your data, so you can test a schema change against real rows without touching shared environments.

## Preview branches

- Branches are created from any environment with `tessera branch create`.

- Copies share storage until they diverge, so creation takes seconds.

- Branches are deleted automatically when the pull request is closed.

## Good to know

Branch data counts toward your storage limit while the branch exists. See the **Preview branches** guide in the docs for setup with your CI.
